mission: Test whether the personnel-family evidence supplies an independently recognizable status/operation anchor.
main_result: KI-RO is best constrained as a differential/exception-balance marker rather than specifically 'deficit/missing'.

secure_personnel_witnesses.domain_anchor: Same tablet contains VIR+KA 20; scholarship treats tablet as personnel/ration administration.
Obverse contains an explicit personnel total under KA-PA (VIR 62, *86 20, VIR+*313b 18, TA 4; KU-RO 110).

qualified_personnel_witness.qualification: KI-RO is one element of a three-word heading, so this witness supports the family but is not a pure KI-RO construction.

cross_domain_controls.observation: A SA-RA2 commodity section is followed by KI-RO and another list of the same commodity types with quantities.
cross_domain_controls.implication: KI-RO is not restricted to persons; it can classify a second accounting section over commodities.

cross_domain_controls.observation: Each row has OLIV, *308, and a KI-RO quantity; Cash & Cash derive KI-RO as a numerical differential between actual and reference amounts.
cross_domain_controls.implication: Supports an accounting-difference function, but not a fixed negative sign.

support: Traditional interpretations of KI-RO as deficit/owing.
Personnel lists under KI-RO are naturally compatible with missing/absent persons.
counterevidence_or_ambiguity: Cash & Cash explicitly note taxation/allocation direction is symmetric.
Monti 2012 argues HT123 KI-RO quantities can be positive surpluses, not shortages.
HT88/HT94 list structure identifies an exceptional/differential subset but does not reveal whether its members are missing, additional, owed, owing, exempt, or otherwise outstanding.

support: Works for commodity and personnel contexts.
Explains why KI-RO can head a separate section.
Does not require a fixed arithmetic sign.
Compatible with HT123 being an actual-vs-reference difference.
differential_exception_balance.qualification: This is a functional gloss, not an etymological or lexical translation.

role_test.secure_relation: Entries under KI-RO are members of a differential/exception section.
role_test.direction_reversal_result: No current observation distinguishes the sign/direction of the differential in personnel records.

mission_result.advance: A replicated administrative construction is now established at the structural-functional level: KI-RO introduces a differential/exception section whose enumerated members are totaled by KU-RO.
mission_result.barrier: The semantic polarity and cause of the differential remain unidentified; the construction may be non-verbal.
